title: Saving 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1's DNS cache
dot:
digraph BigPineapple{rankdir=TB;graph[bgcolor="#FFFFFF", fontname="Helvetica", fontsize=11, label="", pad="0.5", nodesep="0.7", ranksep="0.75", splines="polyline"];node[shape=plaintext, fontname="Helvetica", fontsize=10, margin=0, width=0, height=0];edge[color="#F6821F", penwidth=2, arrowsize=0.8];header[label=<
Big Pineapple
DNS cache behind 1.1.1.1
250 billion cache entries at peak
>];scale[label=<
THE SCALING PROBLEM
1 wasted byte x 250B entries
= over 250 GB of extra memory across the fleet
>];opt1[label=<
OPTIMIZATION 1 / 5
Drop leftover capacity
Vec<T> -> Box<[T]> | String -> Box<str>
Saves 64 B/entry + unused heap capacity
>];opt2[label=<
OPTIMIZATION 2 / 5
Merge record section lists
one list + u16 offsets instead of 3 separate
Saves 28 B/entry
>];opt3[label=<
OPTIMIZATION 3 / 5
Drop duplicated owner names
owner: Option<Box<Name>>
omit when owner == query name
most records avoid heap allocation
>];opt4[label=<
OPTIMIZATION 4 / 5
Box big enum variants
RecordData: A/AAAA inline, large variants boxed
~120 B saved per A / AAAA record
>];opt5[label=<
OPTIMIZATION 5 / 5
Store records as raw bytes
one Box<[u8]> + 2-byte length prefixes
packed data, +13% insert throughput
>];results[label=<
FLEET-WIDE RESULTS
5 changes | no speed tradeoff

Memory per entry: 953 B -> 420 B (-56%)
Allocations per entry: 1.1 KB -> 461 B (-58%)
~100 TB memory freed across the fleet
~ RAM in 130 Gen 13 servers

Insert throughput: +43%
Lookup latency: -19%
>];header->scale;scale->opt1;opt1->opt2[style=dashed, color="#90A4AE"];opt2->opt3[style=dashed, color="#90A4AE"];opt3->opt4[style=dashed, color="#90A4AE"];opt4->opt5[style=dashed, color="#90A4AE"];opt5->results[penwidth=2.5];}
